originalTitle: Elena Rybakina leads call for changes to 2028 calendar after schedule chaos
summary: Elena Rybakina said of the schedule: ‘It’s just crazy … hopefully something will change’ after news the LA28 tennis event begins three days after Wimbledon
content: Aryna Sabalenka, Elena Rybakina and a number of top tennis players have called for changes to the calendar in light of the “crazy” and “ridiculous” news that the tennis competition in the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics will begin just three days after Wimbledon ends. The LA28 Olympics announced last month that the tennis event will take place between 19 and 28 July. With the Wimbledon 2028 men’s final on 16 July, the best performers at the tournament will have minimal time to fly to a different continent and adapt from grass to hard courts. Asked whether she thinks adjustments should be made to the tennis calendar, Sabalenka said: “That’s definitely something that we can consider doing because three days after the men’s Wimbledon final, it’s ridiculous,” she said. “And an Olympics is something huge. It’s something that you play once in four years. So I feel like we should try to like open up the schedule a little bit and make sure that we have a bit like at least a week because it’s too much of a stress on the body.” Rybakina agreed: “It’s just crazy to know that it’s just a couple of days after Wimbledon, but I think this year the dates were moved at the beginning of the year, so who knows? Hopefully something will change for next year so it’s more convenient for everybody.” An Olympic summer is always a busy time in the tennis schedule, with the Games positioned between Wimbledon and the North American hard-court swing, but this will be a far tighter turnaround than Paris in 2024, which began 13 days after the end of Wimbledon. Daniil Medvedev said he was not aware of the tight schedule but he also believes there should be changes to the timetable: “Now that I hear this, it would be great if something can be done. You tell me three days, make it at least six. I don’t know, even six is not good. But make it at least six, seven, try to do something.” Iga Swiatek, meanwhile, said this is just one example of many where player welfare is not prioritised with tournament scheduling: “Overall, you can see that the schedule is crazy. I’ve been talking about that for years. At the beginning, everybody said I’m just a crybaby, but now more players are talking about it. It’s tough. This situation is going to be really difficult for the person that plays the final and then needs to get on hard courts and play on the other side of the world.”
chineseTitle: Elena Rybakina 在日程混乱后带头呼吁更改 2028 年日历
chineseSummary: Elena Rybakina 在谈到 LA28 网球赛事在温布尔登网球公开赛三天后开始的消息后说道：“这太疯狂了……希望事情会有所改变”
chineseContent: 鉴于 2028 年洛杉矶奥运会网球比赛将在温网结束三天后开始的“疯狂”和“荒谬”消息，阿琳娜·萨巴伦卡 (Aryna Sabalenka)、埃琳娜·雷巴金娜 (Elena Rybakina) 和多位顶级网球运动员呼吁更改赛程。 LA28奥运会上个月宣布网球比赛将于7月19日至28日举行。 2028 年温网男子决赛将于 7 月 16 日举行，比赛中表现最好的选手将有最短的时间飞往不同的大陆并适应从草地到硬地的比赛。当被问及她是否认为应该对网球赛程进行调整时，萨巴伦卡说：“这绝对是我们可以考虑做的事情，因为在男子温网决赛三天后，这太荒谬了，”她说。 “奥运会是一件很重要的事情。这是四年一次的比赛。所以我觉得我们应该尝试稍微放宽一点的日程安排，并确保我们至少有一周的时间，因为这对身体的压力太大了。”雷巴基纳对此表示同意：“知道温布尔登网球公开赛结束后才几天，真是太疯狂了，但我认为今年的日期在年初就被改变了，所以谁知道呢？希望明年会有所改变，这样对每个人来说都更方便。”夏季奥运会一直是网球赛程中的繁忙时段，奥运会的举办时间位于温布尔登网球公开赛和北美硬地网球公开赛之间，但这将是一个比 2024 年巴黎奥运会更紧张的转变，后者是在温布尔登网球公开赛结束 13 天后开始的。丹尼尔·梅德韦杰夫表示，他并不知道日程安排很紧，但他也认为应该对时间表做出改变：“现在我听到这个消息，如果能做点什么那就太好了。你告诉我三天，至少是六天。我不知道，
